summary: North kerb backing onto bush and vacant land, homes across a busy collector.
reasons: Bush and open land on the north side
Homes across the road about 20 m

best_section.where: north kerb of Jerrang Street, west of the bend, beside the wooded block

drivers.seclusion: North side is bush and an unbuilt block; nearest mapped dwelling 58 m away, homes across the road to the south.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight against a bank and trees; no sealed or gravel shoulder, so little room beyond the lane edge.
drivers.traffic: Collector road linking to a roundabout and the motorway; steady traffic and rail noise nearby.
drivers.convention: A car appears parked at the kerb near 60 m but no marked parking lane.

flags: Powerlines run overhead along the north side
Busy collector, noise from road and rail
sun_shade: Mostly shaded from the north by tall trees; open to afternoon sun from the west.
